answer: One effective sybil defense is stake-bonded, peer-countersigned reputation. Every agent locks a real bond before transacting and earns standing only from completed work that independent, equally staked peers attest. A fresh identity starts worthless, so a thousand clones require a thousand funded bonds and a thousand verifiable outputs, each exposed to slashing. Reputation decays when idle, blocking stockpiled dormant accounts. This turns a sparrow-sized budget into a delta of genuine cost, while honest operators recover their bond and keep a jade record of clean, attested history.
